examples.zh: 请问，这里的售货员在哪儿？
examples.en: Excuse me, where is the shop assistant here?

examples.zh: 那位售货员对客人很热情。
examples.en: That sales clerk is very warm to customers.

examples.zh: 她以前是商店的售货员。
examples.en: She used to be a shop assistant.

examples.zh: 我在窗台上放了一些花。
examples.en: I put some flowers on the windowsill.

examples.zh: 我的手机在窗台上，你看到了吗？
examples.en: My phone is on the windowsill; did you see it?

examples.zh: 窗台很脏，你擦一擦。
examples.en: The windowsill is dirty; give it a wipe.

examples.zh: 我们坐轮船去上海。
examples.en: We are taking a ship to Shanghai.

examples.zh: 河上有很多轮船。
examples.en: There are many ships on the river.

examples.zh: 坐轮船比坐飞机慢多了。
examples.en: Going by ship is much slower than going by plane.

note: Describes a person or a mistake: 太粗心了.

examples.zh: 我太粗心了，忘带手机了。
examples.en: I was so careless; I forgot to bring my phone.

examples.zh: 他做题总是很粗心。
examples.en: He is often careless when doing problems.

examples.zh: 别这么粗心，再检查一遍。
examples.en: Don't be so careless; check it once more.

meaning: short and small (of a person, building, plant)

senses.en: short and small (of a person, building, plant)

examples.zh: 他个子矮小，但是跑得很快。
examples.en: He is small in build but runs very fast.

examples.zh: 路边有几间矮小的房子。
examples.en: There are a few low, small houses by the road.

examples.zh: 这个孩子比同学矮小一些。
examples.en: This child is a bit smaller than his classmates.

note: Formal; used in government and company policy.

examples.zh: 公司的经营方针是让客人满意。
examples.en: The company's guiding principle is to keep customers satisfied.

examples.zh: 国家提出了新的方针。
examples.en: The country put forward a new policy.

examples.zh: 我们要按这个方针来做事。
examples.en: We should work according to this guiding principle.

meaning: to look down on; to despise

senses.en: to look down on; to despise

note: Opposite: 看得起. Not about being unable to see.

examples.zh: 你不要看不起别人。
examples.en: Don't look down on other people.

examples.zh: 他觉得大家都看不起他。
examples.en: He feels that everybody looks down on him.

examples.zh: 我从来没看不起过你。
examples.en: I have never looked down on you.

note: Praises a person who gets things done.

examples.zh: 她又漂亮又能干。
examples.en: She is both pretty and capable.

examples.zh: 我觉得他是个很能干的人。
examples.en: I think he is a very capable person.

examples.zh: 我们经理很能干，什么都会。
examples.en: Our manager is very capable and can do everything.

meaning: to draw a prize; to take part in a lottery

senses.en: to draw a prize; to take part in a lottery

note: Verb-object: 抽一次奖, 参加抽奖.

examples.zh: 买东西满一百块，可以抽奖。
examples.en: If you spend a hundred yuan, you can enter the prize draw.

examples.zh: 他抽奖抽到了一台电视。
examples.en: He won a TV in the prize draw.

examples.zh: 今天晚上公司有抽奖活动。
examples.en: The company has a prize draw tonight.

note: Pattern: 对 + thing + 感兴趣.

examples.zh: 我对中国历史很感兴趣。
examples.en: I am very interested in Chinese history.

examples.zh: 你对什么运动感兴趣？
examples.en: Which sports are you interested in?

examples.zh: 他对这份工作不感兴趣。
examples.en: He isn't interested in this job.

examples.zh: 房间里的电灯坏了。
examples.en: The light in the room is broken.

examples.zh: 天黑了，请把电灯打开。
examples.en: It's dark; please turn on the light.

examples.zh: 床边的电灯很亮。
examples.en: The light by the bed is very bright.

examples.zh: 你能把公司的网址发给我吗？
examples.en: Could you send me the company's web address?

examples.zh: 这个网址不对。
examples.en: This web address is wrong.

examples.zh: 请在网址里输入你的名字。
examples.en: Please type your name in the web address box.

meaning: written notice (e.g. admission or notification letter)

senses.en: written notice (e.g. admission or notification letter)

note: Common in 录取通知书 "admission letter".

examples.zh: 他收到了大学的录取通知书。
examples.en: He received the university's admission letter.

examples.zh: 面试通知书什么时候发？
examples.en: When will the interview notice be sent out?

examples.zh: 请带好通知书去报到。
examples.en: Please bring your notice letter when you register.

note: Also "a skill that takes learning": 做饭也有学问.

examples.zh: 他很有学问，什么都知道。
examples.en: He is very learned and knows everything.

examples.zh: 喝茶也有很多学问。
examples.en: There is a lot of know-how even in drinking tea.

examples.zh: 做学问要认真。
examples.en: Scholarship requires seriousness.

examples.zh: 他从小就养成了看书的习惯。
examples.en: He formed the habit of reading as a child.

examples.zh: 好习惯要慢慢养成。
examples.en: Good habits have to be formed slowly.

examples.zh: 我想养成每天运动的习惯。
examples.en: I want to form the habit of exercising every day.

note: Hospital department: 挂内科 "register for internal medicine".

examples.zh: 我想挂内科的号。
examples.en: I'd like to register for internal medicine.

examples.zh: 内科在三楼，请坐电梯。
examples.en: Internal medicine is on the third floor; please take the elevator.

examples.zh: 她是内科医生。
examples.en: She is an internal medicine doctor.

examples.zh: 这张光盘里有很多歌。
examples.en: This CD has many songs on it.

examples.zh: 现在很少有人用光盘了。
examples.en: Hardly anyone uses discs any more.

examples.zh: 老师给了我们一张学习光盘。
examples.en: The teacher gave us a study disc.

meaning: to draw up; to formulate (a plan, rule)

senses.en: to draw up; to formulate (a plan, rule)

note: Used with 计划, 规定, 方案.

examples.zh: 我们先制订一个学习计划吧。
examples.en: Let's draw up a study plan first.

examples.zh: 公司制订了新的规定。
examples.en: The company has formulated new rules.

examples.zh: 这个计划是谁制订的？
examples.en: Who drew up this plan?

note: For feelings or foundation: 深厚的友谊.

examples.zh: 我们之间的感情很深厚。
examples.en: The bond between us is very deep.

examples.zh: 他对家乡有深厚的感情。
examples.en: He has deep feelings for his hometown.

examples.zh: 她的中文基础很深厚。
examples.en: Her foundation in Chinese is very solid.

examples.zh: 这条河又宽广又干净。
examples.en: This river is both wide and clean.

examples.zh: 站在山上，眼前是宽广的草地。
examples.en: Standing on the mountain, a vast grassland lies before you.

examples.zh: 这片草地很宽广，孩子可以在这里跑。
examples.en: This meadow is wide; children can run around here.
